snr_truth_use: offline reporting only; never threshold/bin selection or deployment

tdl.normalization: unit ensemble PDP; cir_to_time_channel normalize=False; no per-realization scaling
tdl.waveform: sample-rate time-varying linear convolution with sinc fractional-delay taps; known l_min FFT phase compensation
tdl.label: exact diagonal OFDM transfer coefficient: FFT of mean effective taps across each128-sample receive window with timing phase compensation; ICI remains in received waveform

bootstrap.unit: whole paired frame; same multiplicities across methods and seeds
bootstrap.seed_treatment: primary intervals conditional on five retained trained models: average paired per-frame quantity before frame bootstrap; also descriptive crossed5-seed bootstrap for seed sensitivity
bootstrap.stratified: resample within true-SNR strata for per-SNR tables, within estimated-SNR strata for stratum results
bootstrap.conditional: recompute harmful-accepted/accepted separately per seed then equal-seed mean; undefined resamples counted and omitted; >5% undefined => insufficient

comparison_correction: two-sided Bonferroni13 intervals; marginal95% descriptive intervals also retained; separate from calibration family

comparison_details.rotated_harm: mean of joint harmful acceptance under global+90 and-90 on all active elements, first1024 SYN_A test parents; all seeds equally weighted
comparison_details.tdlc_vs_tdla: independent frame bootstrap for the two environments; pair methods/seeds within an environment, not different channel draws
comparison_details.rank_and_aurc: recompute ranking in every whole-frame bootstrap draw, including multiplicities; do not hold test-derived cutoffs fixed

aurc: right-endpoint step integral over coverage[0,1]: (1/N)sum_{m=1}^N risk(m/N); R_J=h_m/N, R_C=h_m/m; lower score first, independent frame tie key; ranks diagnostic only

timing.boundaries: C_val: FFT grid to selected channel including candidates/scoring/refit; C_rx: CP buffer to hard bits; G3 reuses validation detections
timing.paired_intervals: paired frame clusters preserving all30 repetitions; descriptive repetition-level variability also reported
timing.inference: only G3/G2 half-holdout25/50 ratios are revised inferential timing comparisons;75 and other variants descriptive
timing.frequency: record Windows active power plan and CPU clock information; no governor or OS changes

compute_budget.rule: no sample-count adaptation; resource interruption => resume exact IDs or report incomplete; no success-dependent stopping

claim_rules.conditional: all5 seeds have a certified useful policy plus independent test coverage/useful>=.05 and accepted>=200; test RC exceeding.05 is reported and marks test corroboration NOT_SUPPORTED, never recertification
claim_rules.joint: same useful criteria; joint population certificate is a calibration statement, not a claim every test estimate<=alpha
claim_rules.comparative: directional benefit only if the specified Bonferroni-adjusted paired interval excludes0 (ratio excludes1); otherwise INCONCLUSIVE or NOT_SUPPORTED
claim_rules.standardized: TDL-A certificate applies only to its freshly calibrated IID model; TDL-C and all interventions empirical stress tests without transferred guarantee
claim_rules.failures: reject-all is NOT_SUPPORTED useful calibration; harmful invariant acceptance is LIMITATION_CONFIRMED; no seed exclusions or retuning
